animations.title: Walking
animations.action: Action: eight-frame seamless WALK-IN-PLACE cycle facing left in the same three-quarter view as 01e. Show real alternating leg articulation: 1 left front paw forward/right front back, 2 contact, 3 pass under torso, 4 opposite front paw lifts, 5 opposite forward contact, 6 contact, 7 pass, 8 returning to frame 1. Hind legs alternate appropriately in a quadruped walking gait. Torso has only a tiny up/down bob; three heads stay recognizable and gently bob, three tails sway slightly. No props. End pose connects naturally to first pose. Full-body standing, not sitting.

animations.title: Sitting idle
animations.action: Action: eight-frame gentle SITTING IDLE loop. Creature sits on golden haunches in same three-quarter view, both tabby front legs vertical and both paws planted, golden hind legs folded naturally. Three tails spread visibly behind to the right. Frame 1 calm sitting eyes open; 2 slight inhale chest rises; 3 one tiny ear twitch; 4 eyelids half down; 5 all three blink closed; 6 eyes reopen; 7 slight exhale and gentle tail sway; 8 returns to calm pose. Barely perceptible body movement, stable paws and torso anchor. No props. The creature is sitting in ALL eight frames; no standing or walking. Seamless loop.

animations.title: Tennis ball
animations.action: Action: eight-frame vignette in SITTING pose: a small lime-green TENNIS BALL with one cream curved seam bounces at lower LEFT, distracting ONLY THE TWO DOG HEADS. The cat stays composed looking forward, unchanged eyes and face throughout. 1 seated creature calm, tennis ball near lower left; 2 ball rises, Pom notices and turns gaze left; 3 ball higher, both dogs perk their ears and turn their muzzles/gaze toward ball; 4 both dog heads track ball upward excitedly; 5 ball descends, both dogs lean slightly left watching; 6 ball reaches floor, Pom tilts and larger dog opens mouth slightly; 7 ball rebounds gently and dog heads track it; 8 ball low and heads return toward pose 1. One single connected body stays planted; no chasing, no extra animals. Show a genuinely changing ball position and dog head/ear poses, cat remains disinterested. Exactly ONE ball in each frame. Natural return to frame 1.

animations.title: Food can

ALL THREE pets visibly react together, including cat, no unchanged indifferent face.
